reviews.text: Me and my pup are learning a lot from each session.

Destiny was a pleasure to work with and she provided a great tool to help Piper with manners. She explained everything clearly and answered all my questions. Destiny was nice enough to video tape the training approach so I could remember to practice at home.

I enrolled my two and half Golden Doodle
in the Ahwatukee location in December and couldn’t be happier with the results, believe it or not she “focuses “. on command including before jumping..I love the tools they teach to help train and their disposition . Very friendly, safe environment for your puppy’s and you!

I started Zoom Room Ahwatukee with my dog Meeka 3 weeks ago and have had an amazing experience. Our trainer Madi is great at breaking things down and providing support. I have the monthly reoccurring plan, its super easy to choose classes that fit my schedule and there are so many options for class times and types of classes. We cannot wait to advance up through the training milestones with Zoom Room. Highly recommend!

We’re starting our second month at Zoom Room….Madi Has been our trainer and has been incredible… She’s patient
, kind, and very knowledgeable….She has taken our dog from being absolutely petrified on a harness and leash to walking freely…. She has worked with Coco on agility, obedience and confidence…. She’s absolutely amazing…. Katie has worked with scheduling and accommodates  with a smile every time…. Such a pleasure…. I look forward to every week…. Thank you you guys!

Puppy classes with Madi have been amazing! Super educational and shes always willing to answer all our questions and give us honest advice! Shoutout to Katie as well for being so helpful and friendly! 💗

Just started taking my 6 month old puppy to zoom room ahwatukee!!  My favorite is the puppy play time but the training is great too.  Madi, the trainer, gives you tools to deal w all types of puppy behavior and create a confident happy dog

EVERYONE AT THE ZOOM ROOM REALLY CARES ABOUT YOU AND YOUR DOG!

I brought my rescue dog Lola to Zoom Room hoping to get some help with her intense anxiety and fear issues. She is very reactive to new sounds, people, dogs, environments. She has been scared of everything and responding with undesirable behavior, ie, trying to nip at your hands or feet. She also tries to guard me from other family members or our other dog. After going through different trainers and methods, Lola didn't seem to improve in her responses.

I found Zoom Room through Woofstock Festival and decided to sign Lola up for a free evaluation. After meeting with Kat, she suggested I enroll Lola in one on one private sessions.

We have been working with Kat and John for the past couple of months. They have been so kind and patient in trying to understand Lola's reactions and THEY GO ABOVE AND BEYOND YOUR EXPECTATIONS! When I mentioned some of the ways Lola acts out at home, Kat had me record videos so she could watch them and truly gauge if I should be concerned or not. I told John that walking Lola is often challenging because she's always got her head on a swivel. He took Lola for a little walk down to Fry's where Lola was super stimulated. He demonstrated to me how to handle her when she's reacting to dogs, people, cars, noises etc. He brought his calm dog to a session so we could specifically work on how Lola reacts to another dog. At every class, they ask you what you want to focus on and then they dive in.

The trainers have taught me how to manage your Lola when she's in a heightened state of anxiety and how to recondition her behavior in a positive manner. Lola has shown small but significant improvements in learning to trust strangers. We are still working on socializing her outside of the house in short increments but I feel less anxious now that I have the tools the trainers have given me.

The staff at Zoom Room are all so understanding when Lola shows up for class and starts barking at someone new.

THE ZOOM ROOM IS THE BEST!
Great place for dog training.  John does a great job connecting with dogs.  My puppy instantly loved him.
John is the man! I thought we could learn everything on instagram but it was great to work with a trainer in person.  He immediately had our puppy focused and behaving right.

I've been working with John, Kat and Katie for several months now to teach my dog, Josie, better manners and obedience.  More than that, I have learned so much about how I should be training her, how to help her learn and how I can be a better dog mom.  We've still got some work to do, but she's improving so much that I have signed up my 7 yr old dog to start school, too.  Thank you John and Katie for working with us.

We've had an amazing experience at Zoom Room! We graduated from Puppy Training with Destiny and Bae and are now in Obedience 1 with Maddie. Every trainer we've worked with has been knowledgeable, encouraging, and genuinely invested in helping our puppy succeed.

We've seen so much progress in our puppy's behavior and confidence, and the classes are always fun and engaging. Maddie has been wonderful to work with and does a great job teaching both dogs and owners.

A special shout out to Katie at the front desk, who is always so sweet, welcoming, and helpful.

We always look forward to coming to playgroup and class and highly recommend Zoom Room to anyone looking for a positive training experience!

Tried them for the first time this year. We’ve only been taking the agility classes, but my dog is insanely excited to be a part of every class! The trainers focus on positive reinforcement and can sense when the dog needs a break. I’ve already learned lots of tips on how a dog thinks and how what I’m doing contributes to that. The only thing keeping it from a five star is that it is a bit pricey.

Really love the flexibility and the fun classes at Zoom room. Whether it's an obedience class or agility class my 3 year old belgian malinois gets great work in when he goes. Shout out to trainer John who really made headway with my dog's confidence in getting a new skill. And also appreciate Katie assisting me with class scheduling. Sawyer, Madi and Destiny are wonderful to work with!

We adopted a very sweet (and very spicy) goldendoodle with barrier reactivity. He likes to bark and lunge, which is problematic when trying to walk a big 85lb+ dog. Madi has greatly helped us by teaching us recognize his triggers and by providing us with practical tips on what to do in the moment. He is thriving with the consistent structure, has made huge improvements in his focus, and is much easier to walk (but still a little spicy). It's a long journey, but every day he gets a little better, and we are confident that the tips Madi gave us will help him be a calmer and happier dog.

We’re SO glad we found Zoom Room! We were initially drawn to them because they offer indoor puppy play group classes - and we weren’t big on dog parks. We had a 6 month old puppy at the time who we wanted to socialize more and play safely with other kind and healthy pups! I love that they require an evaluation and vaccinations to keep all the dogs safe and that group is supervised by a trainer. My golden retriever LOVES coming every week for play group and he refuses to leave after! The trainers are wonderful and you can really tell they love their jobs. The facility is nice and clean! Would highly recommend for puppies age 4-8 months to sign up for the play group!
We have been taking our new puppy to Zoom Room Ahwatukee for 2 months now!  We love it.  The trainers and staff are great. Shout out to Madi!

Our family is so pleased that our dog Lucy is receiving training from true professionals! Lucy is becoming more well-behaved. Our trainer Kat is a ROCKSTAR. Knowledgeable about Lucy’s reactive style and focused on helping us with strategies to achieve our goals. Weekly homework has helped Lucy (and our family) make important changes. Surprisingly, the pricing is very reasonable. We are grateful to have the Zoom Room here in the Ahwatukee area. Thank you!

We love taking our puppy to Zoom Room! We've had two different trainers so far and both are EXCELLENT! We've learned a ton and have had great exposure for our puppy. The only issue we've had is booking on the app and app/website in general. But we just have them sign us up for classes.

We love Zoom Room!
My dog is always super excited to go there.
We noticed better behavior in our dog with just 3 to 5 weeks of training. The trainers are super nice, very welcoming, and helpful. They’re also super flexible with schedules.
They share tools with you and specific tips that you can address at home. They have a cool plan for you and your dog to pursue goals and keep the classes interesting and exciting. And you can even take your dogs for a play time with other dogs  (basically an indoor dog park, excellent for the summer).
We really enjoy going, I can’t recommend this place more.

We have been bringing our puppy here for 2 months for "Puppy Preschool" and it is the highlight of our week! The trainers have been so helpful, teaching us how to teach our puppy and generalize these essential skills to home. At just 4 months old, our puppy knows so many important commands and has been growing her impulse control skills. The trainers do an excellent job of offering guidance for things we may be struggling with at home (for example, jumping on visitors). They are all very knowledgable and approachable. We love Zoom Room!

Love taking our fur babies to the Zoom Room. Great friendly and knowledgeable staff and trainers  that are patient with us and the dogs. They train with positivity to creat a safe environment for the dogs. They are very attuned to the wellfare of the dogs so that everyone (people and pets) feel safe with one another. We love that dog advancement is based on their skill level to ensure they really know their stuff.
This is a brand new facility that just recently opened. The employees are knowledgeable trainers who will help you with all of your dog’s needs. The owners are the best! Go check it out!

I have nothing but amazing things to say about this location. Took our 2 dogs for training and socialization and the staff, facility and everyone is so amazing. I highly recommend this place! They’re not only great but their plans work! This has been such a positive experience.

This place is great! They just opened so I would get in before these guys are totally slammed. Everyone who had worked with us has not only taught my pup alot but they do an amazing job informing you why they use the strategies they do! Highly recommend 👌

The Zoom Room in Ahwatukee is absolutely fantastic! The facility is large, spotless, and incredibly inviting. It’s the perfect environment for both dogs and their humans. Kat, the manager, has worked with our very reactive American Bulldog, Juniper, for the past year as a private trainer, and the transformation has been life changing. Now that she’s managing the Zoom Room in Ahwatukee, we have so many new opportunities to continue Juniper’s training and build her confidence.

They offer a great variety of classes, from puppy preschool and obedience to calm down and agility training and every session is fun, structured, and effective. We recently enrolled Juniper in Agility Fundamentals, and she’s having the time of her life! Every trainer Kat has brought onto her team is kind, patient, and highly skilled, so we never have to worry about who’s leading the class, shout out to Destiny and Madi!!!

The facility is well equipped with top-notch training tools and equipment, and they even carry healthy snacks and high quality dog toys for sale. If you’re looking for a positive, professional, and genuinely caring training environment, The Zoom Room in Ahwatukee is the place to be.

What a great facility! Whether your dog needs training, coaching, agility work or just an opportunity to expend some energy, this is the place!!! I had the chance to work with Kat and Sarah, both of whom are extremely knowledgeable, friendly and professional and were able to coach ME on how to better handle my dogs! I will be back!
Fantastic team and place! We saw huge improvements in our pup thanks to Zoom Room. They are patient, kind, and very educated on how to help you and your dog. So many classes to choose from too!

We have loved our experience taking training classes and doing doggie social gatherings at Zoom Room in Ahwatukee.  Our puppy has come a long way way of his impulse control (quite the thing for Corgis).  The facilities are first rate and the trainers are patient and really know what they are doing.  It's a blast!
Really enjoy our experience so far. Professional and helpful advise for out 6 month old German Shepherd puppy .
